# Wait for settled .neo-focus border in NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs

Self-assigned maintainer regression fix (`@neo-gemini-julia`) promoted from `@neo-opus-grace`'s `defect-note` (`MESSAGE:00b7edd9` / `MESSAGE:fe92e66a`) on our recent PR `#21773` (`#21744`); active CI flake already hit on `#21791` shard `7/14`.

## Context

Observed on `neomjs/neo#21791` CI run `44921904819` (`e2e-engine (7/14)`):

```text
rendering/NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs:92 at :185:
Expected: "rgb(221, 221, 221)"
Received: "rgb(28, 96, 160)"
```

`test/playwright/e2e/rendering/NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs:182-185` was added in PR `#21773` (`a9beab77f7`, `Resolves #21744`) to verify focus-border parity between `Neo.form.field.Select` and `Neo.form.field.Text` across all five shipped themes.

## The Problem

Two asynchronous steps sit between `await textInputEl.focus()` (`NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs:182`) and `textInputEl`'s settled active `borderTopColor`:

1. **Worker `.neo-focus` round-trip (`src/form/field/Text.mjs` + `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css:62-80`):** Unlike `Select.css:37-40` (which applies `border-color: var(--selectfield-focus-color)` immediately on native `:focus`), `Text.css:62-80` applies `var(--textfield-border-color-active)` only after the App Worker processes the focus event and sends back the VDom delta adding `.neo-focus` to the field root. Under CI CPU load, line 183 (`textInputEl.evaluate(...)`) runs before `.neo-focus` lands on Main and captures the unfocused resting border (`rgb(221, 221, 221)`), causing line 185 (`expect.poll` on `selectEl`) to compare the focused `<select>` border (`rgb(28, 96, 160)`) against the text field's unfocused grey.
2. **`250ms` CSS `border-color` transition (`resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css:450` & `Select.css:26`):** Both `.neo-textfield-input` (`Text.css:450`) and `.neo-selectfield-input` (`Select.css:26`) declare `transition: 250ms border-color cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`. Reading `getComputedStyle(...).borderTopColor` on the first frame after `.neo-focus` lands (or right after a theme switch / blur at lines 131–141 while a `CSSTransition` is still running) can sample an interpolated mid-transition RGB instead of the settled active or resting border token.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs:125-186` drives five themes (`neo-dark`, `neo-light`, `dark`, `light`, `cyberpunk`) on `examples/form/field/select/index.html`.
- For the plain reference `textfield` (`#${textFields[0].id}`), the focus class `.neo-focus` lands on `#${textFields[0].id}` and `border-color` transitions on `.neo-input-wrapper` / `.neo-textfield-input` (`el.getAnimations()` exposes active `CSSTransition` instances while `playState === 'running'`).
- Design authority: `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css:62-80,450` and `resources/css/src/form/field/Select.css:26,37-51` + `.agents/skills/whitebox-e2e/references/whitebox-e2e-protocol.md` §3 (*"Wait for what the test acts on... never a sleep"*).

## The Fix

In `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs`:
1. At theme-switch / blur setup (`:136-150`), wait for neither field root to carry `.neo-focus` and for `getAnimations()` on both border boxes (`sel` and `txtBox`) to have zero running transitions before snapshotting `closed`.
2. At focus parity (`:189-210`), after `await textInputEl.focus()`, poll until `#${textFields[0].id}` carries `.neo-focus`, `txtBox.getAnimations()` has zero running transitions, and `getComputedStyle(txtBox).borderTopColor !== closed.textBorder` before reading `textFocusBorder`, then focus `selectEl` and poll until its `borderTopColor` settles to `textFocusBorder`.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **`AC-1` (Settled `.neo-focus` & Transition Gate):** `NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs` waits for `#${textFields[0].id}` to carry `.neo-focus` and finish its `border-color` transition (`borderTopColor !== closed.textBorder` and zero running animations on the border element) before reading `textFocusBorder`, and waits for running border transitions to finish after blur/theme change before snapshotting `closed`.
- [ ] **`AC-2` (Repeat-Run Stability):** `npx playwright test --config=test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/rendering/NativeSelectNL.spec.mjs --repeat-each=5` passes `20/20` locally with zero flakes across all five themes.

## Out of Scope

- Changes to `src/form/field/Select.mjs`, `Text.css`, or `Select.css` (the `250ms` border transition and worker-managed `.neo-focus` class are intentional engine behavior).

## Avoided Traps

- **Polling `.neo-focus` alone without waiting for `CSSTransition` completion:** On the frame `.neo-focus` arrives, `Text.css:450`'s `250ms border-color` transition has just started (`t ≈ 0–16ms`), so `getComputedStyle(txtBox).borderTopColor` can return an interpolated RGB value that `selectEl` transitions past. Checking `getAnimations().every(a => a.playState !== 'running')` alongside `.neo-focus` and `!== closed.textBorder` waits deterministically with zero hardcoded `waitForTimeout`.
